reason: The 'no wall of red' part actually gets me, so I'd grab the free plan and play with it for a week, but I've done that with Sunsama and Akiflow and I always drift back to just Google Calendar. I'm not putting $12 a month on another planner until it survives past the novelty phase.
objection: A popup asking 'done, push, shrink or drop' every time a block ends sounds like exactly the kind of nagging that makes me close an app forever, and it doesn't even say if it talks to my iCloud calendar.
would_change_my_mind: If after the trial I'm still opening it daily without forcing myself and it pulls in both my work Google and personal iCloud calendars, I'd pay.
